name: @fasti/monorepo
description: Fasti — an identity-first local system of record for media activity

scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter @fasti/tokens build && pnpm --filter @fasti/sdk build && pnpm --filter @fasti/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @fasti/tokens build && pnpm --filter @fasti/sdk build && pnpm --filter @fasti/ui build && pnpm --filter @fasti/web build
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm contracts:validate-authored && pnpm contracts:validate-generated && pnpm contracts:validate-examples && pnpm contracts:validate-okf && pnpm lint:ui && node scripts/check-js-workspace.mjs && node --test tests/js/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build && mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/js-lcov.info tests/js/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @fasti/tokens typecheck && pnpm --filter @fasti/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @fasti/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @fasti/web typecheck
